name: New Game Flow Test
description: End-to-end play like a player in one process: front-end menu → Play → the cthangover card → New game → in-process mod-set switch → the prologue in prolog_alley with Marao's dialog → in-game hot reload of starter_party (session restored) → menu → card_novel → menu → cthangover again; every released mod context must be collected.
